verdict.rationale: Lago's developer page documents an OpenAPI 3.1 schema that can be used to generate clients or expose billing actions to AI agents. A probe confirmed a live, downloadable spec at https://getlago.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), and the API reference says every endpoint has a generated command. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration that the spec is complete and accurate.
